Covers (Nov 5): Orlando ranks 25th in defensive rating, so it cannot count on its defense to carry it without Suggs; helps Suns.
Covers (Nov 5): Orlando has won two of its three road games; mild help for Magic.
[angle] Covers (Nov 5): Desmond Bane shoots 37.3% from three on 9.6 attempts and Phoenix allows 5.1 threes a game to opposing shooting guards; matchup helps Magic.
[angle] Covers (Nov 5): Devin Booker scored 33 in the Portland loss, averages 24.7 with 27.2% usage, and Miles Bridges is 7-for-12 from three over two games; helps Suns.
Slate/ESPN: open -1.5, close -1.5 (no move); total 224.5 to 222.5; a steady line through the back-to-back news suggests the market saw it as balanced.
Dimers model (Nov 5): projects Suns 112-110 with Suns -1.5 covering 51.1%; Covers' writer took Magic +1.5. Public models split, neutral.
games.reasoning: A near pick'em with offsetting factors: Phoenix's back-to-back, four-game slide and last-ranked defense against an Orlando offense stuck under 100 without Banchero and Suggs. The projection is within a point of the 1.5 line and the close never moved, so pass. A Booker absence would have made it a Magic lean.
